summary: Add durable native fleet roll receipts and fleet/roll-completion: every immutable target host independently verifies the exact target within 24h, with a roll-level 10% allowance over 30 days and existing native owner episodes.

replay.detail: Daemon startup replays the authoritative local roll-receipts.sqlite3 ledger before serving. Receipts retain version-1 reader validation and immutable keys; failed ingestion does not publish source state. No replicated graph replay or convergence corpus changes.

schema.detail: New local-only SQLite receipts table with ordered immutable version-1 JSON bodies, unique receipt keys and admission timestamps. No new claim kinds, graph migrations, generated schema, replicated retention rules or wire client routes. POST /v1/slo accepts the same typed receipt contract as fractal slo ingest-roll FILE.

rules.detail: One known event per fleet roll. Declaration precedes all build/admission/drain/hold effects; revisions and target cohort cannot change. Optional expected realized paths never delay declaration. Verified evidence requires exact active/expected paths, declared constraints, independently applied factory revision, and ready running daemon full compiled revision. Negative adoption requires complete nonempty proof and an actual mismatch/not-ready result; missing or mislabeled negative proof is refused. Missing/unknown/stale evidence and predeadline nonadoption remain unknown. Late verification or post-deadline nonadoption accounts a miss at the original deadline; timely completion accounts at last host verification. Holds never pause time. Each budget window requires 90% known coverage against its relevant overdue unknown rolls; unknowns never enter the good/bad denominator. Existing paired burns and indicator.native ownership apply.

compatibility.detail: Existing SLO reads gain one generic native row; personal fleet producers and owner declarations remain outside public defaults. The population is only locally accepted declarations, with external population coverage explicitly unknown. Older daemons cannot ingest this source, but do not modify its separate ledger.

downtime.detail: No interruption beyond installing/restarting the daemon. Local receipt replay completes before request serving.

manual.detail: The deployment authority must ingest the complete declaration before its first effect and import immutable host observations. Configure an ordinary native objective binding for Deployer ownership. Preserve roll-receipts.sqlite3 and its SQLite WAL in source backups; graph-only exports do not include it.

recovery.detail: Keep authoritative receipt state indefinitely. Restart reconstructs the in-memory source from committed receipt order; exact retries are idempotent and immutable conflicts are refused. Reimport original receipt files in declaration-first order if restoring a lost local source. An absent source or observation is unknown, never invented coverage or success.
